meta.name: opencode-env-setup
meta.description: 從零把 OpenCode 環境裝好——OpenCode 桌面版與 CLI、Git、GitHub CLI、Node.js、uv，先偵測再安裝、每步驗證。說「建置環境」「安裝 OpenCode」「安裝開發環境」「環境建置」時載入。

copy.tagline: 自动搭建 OpenCode 开发环境
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在电脑上从零配置 OpenCode 开发所需工具
copy.tagline_en: Automatically set up OpenCode development environment
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to configure all tools for OpenCode development from scratch

howto.what: 当你需要搭建 OpenCode 开发环境时，Claude 会先检查你的电脑上是否已安装 OpenCode 桌面版、CLI、Git、GitHub CLI、Node.js、uv 等工具，然后自动安装缺失的组件，每步都会验证成功后才继续。
howto.when: 当你说出「建置环境」「安装 OpenCode」「安装开发环境」等关键词时触发。

say.text: 帮我建置 OpenCode 环境
say.note: Claude 会开始检测并安装所需工具

say.text: 安装 OpenCode 桌面版和 CLI
say.note: Claude 会自动检测现有版本，跳过已装的
Claude 会依次检查并安装 Git、Node.js 等

howto.what_en: When you need to set up the OpenCode development environment, Claude will first check if your computer already has the required tools: OpenCode Desktop, CLI, Git, GitHub CLI, Node.js, uv. Then it will automatically install missing components and verify each step.
howto.when_en: When you say keywords like "build environment", "install OpenCode", "set up development environment", this skill is triggered.

say_en.note: Claude will start detecting and installing tools
It will skip already installed ones

say_en.text: Set up the entire development environment
say_en.note: Claude will check and install Git, Node.js, etc.
